messages.subject: server.R failed to response
parts:
Hi,

I moved our project from glimmer.rstudio.com/wush978/LOLChampion to http://wush978.shinyapps.io/LOLChampion/

The code is the same, but the server.R failed to response on shinyapps.

I am not sure if the reason is that my app queries an external database: http://loltw.gamebase.com.tw . Maybe the network of the instance is limited.

Could you help me debug for this?

Thanks.

Wush
